disclosure: Illustrative stock photography for a fictional beauty shopping demo. Packaging, models and photographed makeup results do not depict actual DEWY CO. products, customers, founders, shade results or endorsements.
processing: Downloaded as JPEG in sRGB at quality 85, original aspect ratio retained; hero width 1600px, remaining photographs width 900px. No brand replacement, retouching or synthetic image generation. Pexels origin and attribution embedded as JPEG COM metadata; pixels are unchanged.
inspection: All twelve downloaded files passed Pillow JPEG verification and full pixel decoding. All twelve final photographs were visually inspected together in a labeled contact sheet, after comparison with alternative Pexels images. No obvious competitor wordmarks were observed at the contact-sheet inspection scale; this is not trademark clearance.
limitations: Hero is a tight portrait for a separate right-half campaign panel, not a full-width photograph with empty space for copy.
Highlight photograph shows an illustrative powder compact rather than the fictional highlight stick. Lip and blush photographs demonstrate color application rather than fictional packaging.
Stock makeup and skincare photographs do not establish formula performance, actual shades, ingredient identity, ingredient sourcing or clinical outcomes.
Pexels permits website use but forbids implying endorsement by photographed people or brands. Keep the stock photography disclosure visible.
